contexts.text: Spirits who are let out from some infernal Society into the sphere of a man's life converse together about things that are adverse to the man; hence there generally flow in sadness, anxiety, etc. Such have often been with me, and infused anxieties into the region of the stomach, of which I did not know the source, but when detected, I heard that they had conversed about things that were adverse to my affections.
Man's will runs counter to the Lord's.
